messages.subject: Re: Formatting Table
parts:
Hey,

As the tables are standard html it is fairly easily to add some css styles to format it.

Have a look at this link: Formatting Tables

Just put your stylesheet in the www folder and add the tags$head and tags$link tags at the top of your ui.R file.

The standard renderTable has a class called .table-bordered so just use that in your css.

EG,

tags$head(
tags$title('Table Formatting'),
tags$link(rel = 'stylesheet', type = 'text/css', href = 'stylesheet.css')
),
